label: TP
reason: Two distinct vulnerabilities exist: 1) Weak randomness via java.util.Random().nextLong() for authentication key generation (line 90) - this is a known insecure pattern that allows predictable tokens. 2) XSS via unsanitized concatenation of rememberMe.getValue() and related strings to response output (lines 99-104) - user-controlled cookie values are directly rendered without HTML encoding.

evidence.note: Weak Random nextLong() used for authentication key
Unsanitized concatenation of cookie values to HTML output
